fn command_shape(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = text(getfield(c, "op"))
  demand(elem(op, ["create", "read", "drop", "apply"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  if op == "apply" then
    fields(c, ["op", "changes"])
    let changes = arr(getfield(c, "changes"))
    demand(length(changes) >= 1 && length(changes) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    for change in sof(changes) do
      validate_change(change)
  else
    fields(c, if op == "create" then ["op", "view", "sql", "optimize"] else ["op", "view"])
    demand(view_name(text(getfield(c, "view"))), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    if op == "create" then
      let ignored = text(getfield(c, "sql"))
      demand(value_type(getfield(c, "optimize")) == "bool", "INVALID_COMMAND")

fn view_name(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 40
    && byte_at(s, 0) >= 97 && byte_at(s, 0) <= 122

new.name: finish
new.source:
fn finish(plan : Plan, projected : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

fn base_table(t : Table) : Base =
  var live := map_empty
  var used := map_empty
  var n := 1
  for r in sof(t.rows) do
    live := map_insert(n, LiveRow { position = n, row = r }, live)
    used := map_insert(n, true, used)
    n += 1
  Base { table = Table { ..t, rows = [] }, live = live, used = used, next = n }

fn changed_scan(p : Plan, source : Int, old : Base, new : Base, ids : List(Int), rows : Rows) : (Rows, List(String)) =
  var out := rows
  var changed := map_empty
  for id in sof(ids) do
    match map_lookup(id, old.live) of
      Some(r) =>
        let k = position_key(r.position)
        out := map_delete(k, out)
        changed := map_insert(k, true, changed)
      None => ()
    match map_lookup(id, new.live) of
      Some(r) =>
        let k = position_key(r.position)
        if scan_row(p, source, r.row) then
          out := map_insert(k, r.row, out)
        changed := map_insert(k, true, changed)
      None => ()
  (out, map(fst, map_to_list(changed)))

new.ty: forall a b c. (Incremental.Stage, Map(String, List(Json.Json), a), Map(String, List(Json.Json), b), List(String), Map(String, List(Json.Json), c), Map(String, List(Json.Json), c), List(String), Model.Expr, Bool, Int) -> (Incremental.Stage, List(String))
new.source:
fn maintain_join(s : Stage, old_left : Rows, new_left : Rows, dl : List(String), old_right : Rows, new_right : Rows, dr : List(String), on : Expr, outer : Bool, width : Int) : (Stage, List(String)) =
  let li = update_index(s.left_index, s.left_slot, old_left, new_left, dl)
  let ri = update_index(s.right_index, s.right_slot, old_right, new_right, dr)
  var affected := map_from_list(map(\(k) -> (k, true), dl))
  -- Probe both old and new right keys, against final left rows. Changed left
  -- rows are already in affected, including deletions and key changes.
  for k in sof(dr) do
    for right in sof([old_right, new_right]) do
      match map_lookup(k, right) of
        Some(r) =>
          let candidates = lookup(bucket(r, s.right_slot), li, empty_rows())
          for pair in sof(map_to_list(candidates)) do
            affected := map_insert(fst(pair), true, affected)
        None => ()
  var children := s.children
  var out := s.rows
  var delta := map_empty
  for pair in sof(map_to_list(affected)) do
    let k = fst(pair)
    for old in sof(map_to_list(lookup(k, children, empty_rows()))) do
      out := map_delete(fst(old), out)
      delta := map_insert(fst(old), true, delta)
    children := map_delete(k, children)
    match map_lookup(k, new_left) of
      None => ()
      Some(l) =>
        var matches := empty_rows()
        let candidates = lookup(bucket(l, s.left_slot), ri, empty_rows())
        for right in sof(map_to_list(candidates)) do
          let row = append(l, snd(right))
          if truth(evaluate(on, row, [])) then
            matches := map_insert(concat(k, concat("/", fst(right))), row, matches)
        if outer && map_height(matches) == 0 then
          matches := map_insert(concat(k, concat("/", position_key(0))), append(l, replicate(width, JNull)), matches)
        for child in sof(map_to_list(matches)) do
          out := map_insert(fst(child), snd(child), out)
          delta := map_insert(fst(child), true, delta)
        children := map_insert(k, matches, children)
  (Stage { ..s, left_index = li, right_index = ri, children = children, rows = out }, map(fst, map_to_list(delta)))

new.name: maintain_output
new.ty: forall a. (Incremental.View, Map(String, List(Json.Json), a), List(String)) -> Incremental.View
new.source:
fn maintain_output(v : View, joined : Rows, delta : List(String)) : View =
  let p = v.plan
  var filtered := v.filtered
  var dirty := map_empty
  var groups := v.groups
  var projected := v.projected
  for k in sof(delta) do
    match map_lookup(k, v.filtered) of
      Some(row) =>
        if p.aggregate then
          dirty := map_insert(group_key(p, row), true, dirty)
          groups := change_group(groups, p, v.aggs, k, row, -1)
        filtered := map_delete(k, filtered)
      None => ()
    if not(p.aggregate) then projected := map_delete(k, projected)
    match map_lookup(k, joined) of
      Some(row) =>
        if truth(evaluate(p.query.predicate, row, [])) then
          filtered := map_insert(k, row, filtered)
          if p.aggregate then
            dirty := map_insert(group_key(p, row), true, dirty)
            groups := change_group(groups, p, v.aggs, k, row, 1)
          else
            projected := map_insert(k, map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, []), p.query.select), projected)
      None => ()
  if p.aggregate then
    if length(p.query.groups) == 0 then
      dirty := map_insert("[]", true, dirty)
      if not(map_member("[]", groups)) then groups := map_insert("[]", empty_group(v.aggs), groups)
    -- Remove all previous encounter keys before installing any replacements:
    -- a moved row can become the first member of a different group.
    for item in sof(map_to_list(dirty)) do
      match map_lookup(fst(item), v.groups) of
        Some(g) => projected := map_delete(fst(first_member(g)), projected)
        None => ()
    for item in sof(map_to_list(dirty)) do
      let key = fst(item)
      let g = lookup(key, groups, empty_group(v.aggs))
      if map_height(g.members) == 0 && length(p.query.groups) > 0 then
        groups := map_delete(key, groups)
      else
        for row in sof(project_group(p, g)) do
          projected := map_insert(fst(first_member(g)), row, projected)
  let result = finish(p, map(snd, map_to_list(projected)))
  View { ..v, filtered = filtered, groups = groups, projected = projected, result = result }

fn update_index(index : Index, slot : Int, old : Rows, new : Rows, changes : List(String)) : Index =
  var out := index
  for k in sof(changes) do
    match map_lookup(k, old) of
      Some(r) => out := index_remove(out, slot, k, r)
      None => ()
    match map_lookup(k, new) of
      Some(r) => out := index_add(out, slot, k, r)
      None => ()
  out
